firm_data.firm_description: Palermo Law was built by Steven Palermo based on firsthand experience as an injured person navigating the insurance system. Today, that firsthand experience guides Steven and the entire Palermo Law team in representing injured people throughout Long Island and the surrounding communities.
notable_facts: Over $75 million recovered for injured clients.
Recognized as Best of Long Island.

email.subject: AI for Palermo Law, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Steven,

Over $75 million recovered for injured clients on Long Island is a remarkable track record. That kind of success requires precision in case handling, client trust, and lean operational efficiency.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with focused teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we understand the realities of personal injury practices: managing high case volumes without sacrificing quality.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding to meet regional firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your Long Island office to show how ex-lawyers built Lucio to help firms compete with larger competitors while protecting client relationships.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
